newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares trundle lower, seen steady.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares trundle lower, seen steady.

text.p: Austrian shares ended marginally in negative territory on Monday after a session of narrow range-trading on low turnover.
Traders said the market lacked incentives due to a market holiday in the U.S. and see the ATX index hovering between 1,208 and 1,220 points over the short term.
Investors were sitting back, first waiting to see "whether Wall Street continues marching towards 8,000, or whether that was the peak for now," said one trader.
The ATX index lost 0.1 percent to close at 1,212.2 points with nine shares advancing, 11 falling and one unchanged.
The day's top performer was Leykam, adding on 2.78 percent to 314 schillings, while Mayr-Melnhof led decliners, falling 1.78 percent to 606 schillings.
Traders also cited demand in VA Stahl and EVN.
The February ATX future shed 4.6 points to 1,210.8 on turnover of 1,351 lots.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index fell 0.11 percent to 449.64 points. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 256
